integrity: Full proof, normalized angle density, explicit beta change-of-variables, code and reproducible numerical checks are supplied; code tests are corroborative, not proof or external certification.
scientific_limitations: Uniform independent sphere samples in dimension three; Euclidean edge sampled uniformly by count; not length weighted, not a realization-wise ratio; no higher-dimensional or nonuniform claim. The pre-existing spherical Blaschke-Petkantschin decomposition is credited. Historical priority remains provisional and no independent audit has occurred.
title: Exact uniform-edge chord law and quadratic mesh energy of random spherical polytopes
